image_1.instructions: Inspect state.images[0].photo AND its playbackMetadata directly. Account for explicit source-index return playback, source count vs timeline steps, and repeated static endpoint holds. Does it show the named motion with a coherent complete sequence, enough intermediate poses, two arms/two legs and consistent framing? Verify anatomical side where specified. Repeated static hold frames are valid; incorrect arm/leg/side or missing main phases require repair.

criteria.usable: Named movement and meaningful coherent sequence are visible. Minor proportional jitter may remain.
criteria.repair: Material mismatch, extra limb, wrong side, missing main phase or confusing sequence needs repair.
criteria.unclear: Cannot confidently verify named movement or side from image.
